column1: # Question: outside the 11 claim-numeric gates, how many produce green without measuring?
# Not measured: the 468-gate leftover corpus. That number is not derived here.
# Sample: unique scripts/ci/*_gate.sh invoked as a real run: (including bash "$g" inside a run: | block) in jobs.contracts of .github/workflows/ci.yml.
# Why this sample: these are the gates that cost every pull request. A green here is what the fleet treats as a CI signal.
# Every-PR cut: drop any Contracts step whose YAML if: is not empty (impact filters; r6 nightly/schedule). Upload-artifact is not a gate.

# Overlap with the 11 claim-numeric rows: none. Those eleven are not invoked in jobs.contracts. dissertation_confidence_gate_gate.sh and dissertation_frontend_parity_gate.sh sit in this job; they are leftover-budget rows already measured=yes, not members of the 11. They stay in the sample because they cost every PR.

# Runner: this worktree, env scrubbed (no inherited SOUC_BIN / SOUNIO_STDLIB_PATH), SOUNIO_GATE_SOUC + SOUC_BIN + SOUNIO_STDLIB_PATH pinned to this checkout, MADAROS_STACK_KB=524288, ulimit -s 1048576. numpy via `python3 -m pip install --user --break-system-packages numpy` (PEP 668 + no python3-venv on this pod; Contracts uses `python3 -m pip install numpy` on ubuntu-24.04). Same package, not the same install path. This pod has no nvidia-smi / ptxas / nvcc / wine — same class as the 11.
# Cap: 90 s per gate (timeout(1) SIGTERM). A cap is not a measurement.

# Empty-green: rc=0 and the process selected, ran, and measured nothing (SKIPPED / skip-vacuous / capability missing and no science arm ran). A grep/receipt/sha check that actually inspected files is pass-measured, even if cheap.
# pass-measured: rc=0 and a check ran (PASS/FAIL counts, file/sha compare, compiler invocation that produced a verdict).
# This file's counts are filled after the run. They are not a 468 extrapolation. If a reader wants a 468 guess they must say so; the sample does not license it.

# Four logs (parser routing, sigpipe, vacuity, claude contract) used GATE_*_OK / *_PASS / "OK" tokens the first-pass tokeniser missed. Re-read; all four measured. That was a classifier miss, not empty-green.
# Measurement SHA: ee6ec28013d181d7d533383b69ac3a0ae69cbe8a. Workflow blob: 3132a0f1d6b6cc9af5182c396bf71e00733d3234. Cap 90s. Runner /tmp/contracts_empty_green_run.py.
# COUNTS (method above; not a 468 extrapolation). every-pr n=44. pass-measured=44. empty-green=0. red=0. other=0. outside_the_11=44 (overlap with the 11: 0).
